title: Concept: pyproject dependency declared as a direct URL
description: pyproject.toml declares a `name @ url` dependency that bypasses the index, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The artifact is fetched from a URL the index never recorded, so its provenance and hash are whatever that server chooses to serve.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: The artifact is fetched from a URL the index never recorded, so its provenance and hash are whatever that server chooses to serve.
